newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH shares rebound from Friday's fall.
newsitem.headline: LVMH shares rebound from Friday's fall.

text.p: Shares in luxury goods group LVMH rose on Monday, partly recouping a 1.71 percent loss on Friday.
Traders said the rise was mainly technical. One analyst said it was also fuelled by expectations that LVMH's proposed buyout of U.S. duty free chain DFS would close before year's end.

The analyst said Japan's move after the World Trade Organisation meeting in Singapore to narrow the gap between tax on its domestic and imported spirits was also positive for LVMH, which generates a lot of its profits in Japan.
The share was up 1.19 percent at 1,273 francs at 1045 GMT after easing from an early high of 1,288 francs.
Traders said there was an analysts' meeting, citing a report in the press, but the company said there was no meeting.
